我在机场的一天(My Day at the airport): 两人在机场附近聊天,谈到各自的喜好与日常。
Hi, Owen! Are you free now?
Which city do you want to visit?
I go to the park every Friday.
What's more, they met at a quiet cafe.
column3: 他们在一家安静的咖啡馆见面。
